moments.title: Premier League Weekend Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season is in full swing, with Matchweek 1 continuing today and tomorrow, featuring major clubs like Manchester United, Tottenham, Manchester City, and Liverpool.

source.l: Premier League Official Site / The Guardian

angles.name: Today's Games
angles.copy: Premier League Matchweek 1 continues! Today's fixtures include Hull City vs Manchester United, Brentford vs Tottenham Hotspur, and more. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Weekend Football Fever
angles.copy: It's a massive weekend for football fans as the Premier League season gets underway. Manchester City, Liverpool, and Chelsea all play tomorrow. Don't miss a kick!

moments.title: EFL & Local Football Action
moments.blurb: Beyond the Premier League, the Championship, League One, and League Two also have a full schedule of matches today, including Cardiff City and Exeter City.

angles.name: Cardiff City Play Away
angles.copy: Cardiff City are on the road today in the Championship, facing Derby. Huge support from back home in Wales!

angles.name: Exeter City at Home
angles.copy: It's a big match for Exeter City today in League Two as they host Accrington. Let's get behind the Grecians!

moments.title: Creamfields Festival Approaches
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest electronic music festival, Creamfields, takes place next weekend, August 27-30, in Daresbury, Cheshire, featuring huge names like Swedish House Mafia, Calvin Harris, and Tiësto.

angles.name: Creamfields Countdown
angles.copy: Just days to go until Creamfields! Who are you most hyped to see on the lineup? Swedish House Mafia, Calvin Harris, Tiësto... the list goes on!

angles.name: Dance Music Mecca
angles.copy: Creamfields is almost here! Four days of the world's best electronic artists ready to take over Daresbury. Get ready to dance!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Dua Lipa!
moments.blurb: Chart-topping British-Albanian singer Dua Lipa turns 31 today, August 22nd, known for hits like 'New Rules' and 'Levitating'.

angles.name: Celebrating Dua Lipa
angles.copy: A huge happy 31st birthday to the incredible Dua Lipa today! Which of her massive tracks is your all-time favourite?

angles.name: Pop Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy birthday to the one and only Dua Lipa! From 'New Rules' to 'Levitating', she keeps the hits coming.

moments.title: Rick Springfield Turns 77
moments.blurb: Australian-American rock legend Rick Springfield, famous for his 1981 hit 'Jessie's Girl', celebrates his 77th birthday tomorrow, August 23rd.

angles.name: Jessie's Girl Hitmaker
angles.copy: Tomorrow, Rick Springfield turns 77! Still rocking after all these years. What's your favourite track from the 'Jessie's Girl' singer?

angles.name: 80s Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a future happy 77th birthday to the 80s icon, Rick Springfield! Get ready to crank up some classic rock tomorrow.

moments.title: Gene Simmons' 77th Birthday
moments.blurb: KISS bassist and co-lead singer, the iconic Gene Simmons, celebrates his 77th birthday on Tuesday, August 25th.

angles.name: Kiss Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to salute the Demon! Gene Simmons of KISS turns 77 on Tuesday. What's your ultimate KISS anthem?

angles.name: Rock Icon Celebrates
angles.copy: From the stage to the screen, Gene Simmons is a true rock icon. Wishing him a very happy 77th birthday this Tuesday!

moments.title: Shirley Manson Turns 60
moments.blurb: Scottish singer-songwriter Shirley Manson, best known as the lead vocalist of the alternative rock band Garbage, celebrates her 60th birthday on Wednesday, August 26th.

angles.name: Garbage Frontwoman's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 60th birthday to the incredible Shirley Manson of Garbage this Wednesday! Which of their iconic tracks is your favourite?

angles.name: Alt Rock Queen
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring influence of Shirley Manson, who turns 60 on Wednesday. A true queen of alternative rock!

moments.title: Florence Welch's 40th Birthday
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the captivating lead vocalist and primary songwriter of Florence + The Machine, celebrates her 40th birthday on Friday, August 28th.

angles.name: Happy 40th Florence!
angles.copy: Wishing a magical 40th birthday to the phenomenal Florence Welch this Friday! What's your favourite Florence + The Machine song?

angles.name: Florence + The Machine Lead
angles.copy: An iconic voice turns 40 this Friday! Celebrate Florence Welch's birthday by blasting some Florence + The Machine hits!

moments.title: Shania Twain Turns 61
moments.blurb: Canadian superstar Shania Twain, the 'Queen of Country Pop' and one of the best-selling female artists of all time, celebrates her 61st birthday on Friday, August 28th.

angles.name: Queen of Country Pop
angles.copy: Let's go girls! Shania Twain turns 61 this Friday! Get ready to celebrate the Queen of Country Pop with her greatest hits.

angles.name: Still the One
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 61st birthday to the legendary Shania Twain this Friday! She's still the one who can get us singing along.

moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Approaching
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is just over a week away, falling on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Plans
angles.copy: The August Bank Holiday is just around the corner! What are your plans for the long weekend? Making the most of the last blast of summer?

angles.name: Long Weekend Ahead
angles.copy: Get ready for a long weekend! The Summer Bank Holiday on August 31st means an extra day off for many across England, Wales, and Northern Ireland. Start planning now!
